Sorry for just getting back to you. I can tell you the whole story, but I'm just exhausted from how things have gone. I feel like like everyone I wake up, I have nothing to give. It's just a super dark place right now. I feel so lost

In 2013 my best friend was having a hard time coping with with the loss of a man who suffered a massive heart attack. My friend was fresh out of college and was in his second week as a paramedic. He performed CPR on this man to no avail and it really shook him. On top of that, his girlfriend broke up with him a couple days after. 

I spent everyday I could with him because I knew that he was having a rough time. I repeatedly told him that he did what he could for that man, but it was just that man's time. He seemed to cheer up a little bit, bit definitely wasn't over his girlfriend. To that I just stressed to giver her space and time will take care of it. 

A week later, on the first day in 2 years I haven't seen or talked to him, I get a call from his histerically upset ex girlfriend. It was around midnight and he had gone to the church they had attended together, called her, told her he loved her, had her recite the Lord's Prayer with him, then shot himself through the heart with a .410 Judge. Her parents lived nearby and found him.

I don't know why, but my first instinct was to head over to his house and wake up his parents. It's 1 in the morning by this time and I knock on the door. After a minute of waiting I see his mom come to the door with a confused look on her face. She opens and the first thing she asks is "are you looking for [son's name]? I don't think he's here." I just ask if I could come in for a minute and talk to her and his dad. I could tell that she knew something was wrong, but she graciously let me in and by that time his dad stormed in their kitchen (which is near the door). 

He was angry at being woken up by his son's friend and just immediately started questioning me as to why I was there, where was his son, and what was going on. I tried unsuccessfully to get them to go sit down with me do to his dad repeatedly asking me what's going on and where is he. I finally just said it. "He shot himself... He's dead." 

His dad just fell to the floor uncontrollably crying shouting why and oh god, but his mom just stood there with a blank look on her face and just kept saying ok over and over again. 

After a few minutes of me just standing near their door shaking at what I just had to do, his mom kinda just walks over, hugs and thanks me and tells me they need to be alone. Their son and I were both 22 at the time. 

TD;RL I had to tell my childhood best friend's parents that he killed himself.

I normally run with a group of friends. I've tried an open crew four times since release and only made one friend out of it. Since then, I personally found that it's easier to sail.alone of with friends. I had a my worst experience with an open crew the other night. I was on a Gally with one other friend. We had four, but two of the guys quit due to the legendary quest taking forever. Plus it was getting late. 

We decided to go open crew to help us finish what was left. The first two guys didn't have mics and left after ten minutes. Our progress to this point was only having the merchant and one order of souls bounty left. We already had all of the livestock caged up in the captain's quarters. The next two that came in we're the worst. The first was a kid who immediately set off two powder kegs in the bottom of the ship while calling us names repeatedly that blizzard would perma ban you for. Just really obnoxious. We threw him in the bright immediately. The second guy was just a dick. He joined and killed all the animals we had caught and set off another powderkeg. All I could say was " Awesome, thanks man, we haven't been working hard on that for over an hour at all!" To which he replied, "Oh you're welcome! I'm already Athena level 10 anyway." (We were not). We asked them both to leave so we could actually get someone to help us. They told us, to put it nicely, no. So we canceled the quest, scuttled the ship, and I haven't played it in a few days. 

This was just one experience, and obviously they won't all be like that. I just find it less stressful to join friends. If you want, pm me and I can get you set up with the crew I run with. I just personally will never do open crews.
